members.name: columns
members.doc: The columns as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, `isRowHeader`, and `sortable`.

members.name: rows
members.doc: The rows as data: items with an `id` and either a `values` entry or a field of the row for each column id. Selection follows each row's id when the rows reorder, so give every row an id that stays with its data.

members.name: selectedIds
members.doc: The selected row ids when the caller controls the selection, or `'all'`.

members.name: defaultSelectedIds
members.doc: The row ids selected at first when the table controls its own selection, or `'all'`.

members.name: sortDescriptor
members.doc: The sorted column and its direction. A sort shows only when the application passes it back. `column` must be the id of a column with `sortable: true`, or Table throws a TypeError.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the table: rows cannot be selected or acted on, sort changes are ignored, and the root carries `data-muxui-state-disabled`.

members.name: selectionMode
members.doc: How many rows can be selected.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Called with the selected row ids, or `'all'`, when the selection changes. It is not called while the table is disabled.

members.name: onRowAction
members.doc: Called with the row record when the user activates a row. With selection on, a click or Enter runs it while nothing is selected and Space starts a selection; once a row is selected, a click changes the selection instead. It is not called for a disabled row or while the table is disabled.

members.name: onSortChange
members.doc: Called with the column and the next direction when the user activates a sortable header, which toggles between ascending and descending. Table never sorts rows: the application sorts them and passes `sortDescriptor` back. It is not called while the table is disabled.

types.name: MuxUICollectionItem

members.name: value
members.doc: Consumer data; named Select and ComboBox forms submit the item `id`, not `value`.

types.name: MuxUITableColumn

members.name: isRowHeader
members.doc: Marks the column whose cells name their row.

members.name: sortable
members.doc: Gives the column a sortable header: activating it reports the next sort through `onSortChange`.

types.name: MuxUITableRow

members.name: values
members.doc: Cell content by column id.
